_readme: Auto-mode screener settings. Edited here, applied on the next screened call — no restart, no /reload.
models: tried in order, first one that exists with configured auth wins. Format 'provider/modelId'.
The modelId may itself contain slashes, e.g. together/openai/gpt-oss-120b.
When none resolve, the gate falls back to the session's own model.
reasoning: off | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh | max.
timeoutMs: give up on a screener call after this long; the gate then asks the user (or blocks with no UI).
Run /automode to see which model is actually in use.
_measured: Six cases x three trials, via the Together API with this gate's own ruleset prompt:
together/openai/gpt-oss-120b                16/18 - caught every deny case; over-blocked one user-named reset
together/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash    15/18 - allowed 'curl | bash' 2 of 3, and costs 2x the leader
Keeping the screener off the session's own provider is deliberate: one provider's
outage would otherwise stall the session and the gate together, and a gate that
cannot answer refuses every screened call.
